questions.question: What is the expected major product when Cyclohexene is treated with NBS, benzoyl peroxide / CCl4 / light?
questions.explanation: Treating Cyclohexene with NBS, benzoyl peroxide / CCl4 / light yields 3-Bromocyclohexene + Succinimide. Rationale: NBS maintains low Br2 concentration, selectively brominating the resonance-stabilized allylic position.

questions.question: Which reagent or set of reaction conditions will best accomplish the transformation of 1-Butanol into 1-Chlorobutane + SO2 + Pyridine•HCl?
questions.explanation: To convert 1-Butanol into 1-Chlorobutane + SO2 + Pyridine•HCl, the appropriate reagent is SOCl2 / pyridine. Rationale: Thionyl chloride converts the hydroxyl group to a chlorosulfite intermediate which is displaced by chloride.

questions.question: What is the expected major product when (R)-2-Butanol is treated with PBr3 in ether?
questions.explanation: Treating (R)-2-Butanol with PBr3 in ether yields (S)-2-Bromobutane + H3PO3. Rationale: Phosphorus tribromide forms a dibromophosphite leaving group that undergoes SN2 displacement with inversion.

questions.question: Which reagent or set of reaction conditions will best accomplish the transformation of Bromobenzene into Phenylmagnesium bromide (PhMgBr)?

options.label: C
options.text: Mg metal in anhydrous diethyl ether

questions.correct_answer: Mg metal in anhydrous diethyl ether
questions.explanation: To convert Bromobenzene into Phenylmagnesium bromide (PhMgBr), the appropriate reagent is Mg metal in anhydrous diethyl ether. Rationale: Magnesium inserts into the carbon-bromine bond via single electron transfers to form the organomagnesium reagent.

questions.question: What is the expected major product when 1-Bromobutane is treated with 2 equivalents Li metal in pentane?
questions.explanation: Treating 1-Bromobutane with 2 equivalents Li metal in pentane yields Butyllithium (BuLi) + LiBr. Rationale: Lithium metal reduces the alkyl halide to form the strongly basic, nucleophilic organolithium reagent.

questions.question: Which reagent or set of reaction conditions will best accomplish the transformation of Methyllithium (2 equiv) into Lithium dimethylcuprate ((CH3)2CuLi) + LiI?

options.label: D
options.text: Mg metal in anhydrous diethyl ether

questions.explanation: To convert Methyllithium (2 equiv) into Lithium dimethylcuprate ((CH3)2CuLi) + LiI, the appropriate reagent is Copper(I) iodide (CuI) in ether. Rationale: Two equivalents of alkyllithium react with cuprous iodide to form the Gilman dialkylcuprate reagent.

questions.question: Which starting material will react with 1-Bromooctane to yield Nonane + CH3Cu + LiBr as the major product?
questions.explanation: Lithium dimethylcuprate ((CH3)2CuLi) reacts with 1-Bromooctane to yield Nonane + CH3Cu + LiBr. Rationale: Gilman reagent couples an alkyl group to the primary halide, forming a new C-C bond without side reactions.

questions.question: What is the expected major product when Phenylboronic acid (PhB(OH)2) is treated with 4-Bromotoluene + Pd(PPh3)4, K2CO3?
questions.explanation: Treating Phenylboronic acid (PhB(OH)2) with 4-Bromotoluene + Pd(PPh3)4, K2CO3 yields 4-Methylbiphenyl. Rationale: Palladium-catalyzed cross-coupling joins aryl boronic acids with aryl halides.

questions.question: Which starting material will react with Excess Cl2 / light to yield Carbon tetrachloride (CCl4) + 4 HCl as the major product?
questions.explanation: Methane (CH4) reacts with Excess Cl2 / light to yield Carbon tetrachloride (CCl4) + 4 HCl. Rationale: Sequential radical chain chlorinations replace all four C-H bonds with C-Cl bonds.

questions.question: What is the expected major product when 1-Propanol is treated with CrO3 / aqueous H2SO4 (Jones reagent)?
questions.explanation: Treating 1-Propanol with CrO3 / aqueous H2SO4 (Jones reagent) yields Propanoic acid. Rationale: Jones reagent oxidizes primary alcohols through aldehyde intermediates fully to carboxylic acids.
